cityExploration.title: City Exploration
cityExploration.description: Discover the hidden gems and iconic landmarks across the city. Experience the vibrant culture and rich history that make each neighborhood unique.

urbanVisions.title: Local Artist Showcase: Urban Visions
urbanVisions.description: Experience the city through the eyes of its vibrant artist community. Engage with local creators and explore their masterpieces that reflect the spirit of the city.

cityLights.title: City Lights: Nighttime Revelations
cityLights.description: See the city come alive under the twinkling city lights. Enjoy the nightlife with live music, street performances, and bustling night markets.

culinaryDelights.title: Culinary Delights: Flavors of the City
culinaryDelights.description: Taste diverse flavors from the city's renowned culinary scene. From street food to fine dining, savor every bite of local and international cuisines.

cityRhythms.title: City Rhythms: Musical Fusion
cityRhythms.description: Catch the beat of the city's eclectic music and nightlife. Join us for unforgettable live performances and discover the sounds that define the city.

cityscapes.title: Cityscapes: Urban Beauty
cityscapes.description: Admire stunning architectural wonders and city panoramas. Explore breathtaking views from rooftops and enjoy the beauty of urban design and creativity.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Welcome to TOURNEST. Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you use our services.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
items: Personal data (such as name, email, and contact details).
Location data to improve mapping and route services.
Usage data (such as preferences and interactions with the app).

section3.title: 3. Data Security
section3.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal data. However, no method of data transmission is 100% secure, and we encourage users to take precautions when sharing personal information online.

section4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
section4.content: We may share data with third-party services for analytics. These services adhere to strict privacy standards.

section5.title: 5. Your Rights
items: Access, update, or delete your personal information.

section6.title: 6. Changes to This Policy
section6.content: We may update our Privacy Policy periodically. Any significant changes will be communicated to users.
